title: Fourier norm of an extended restriction
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$, let $J\\subseteq\\{1,\\ldots,n\\}$, and fix signs $z$ on the coordinates outside $J$. Extend the restriction of $f$ obtained by fixing those coordinates to a function on the whole cube that ignores coordinates outside $J$. For each set of coordinates $S$, take the Fourier coefficient of this extension when $S\\subseteq J$, and set it to zero otherwise; the sum of the absolute values of these coefficients over all $S$ equals the Fourier one-norm of the extended function.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
$J$ is a subset of the coordinate set
